prompts.idle: Use case: stylized-concept. A production animation sprite sheet: EXACTLY 16 independent full-body poses in a regular 4 columns x 4 rows grid, chronological order left-to-right top-to-bottom. Request canvas 1536 x 1536; each cell is an equal square. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background throughout and transparent gutters. Do not paint any black/white/checkerboard background. No labels, grid lines, numbers, shadows, floor or scene. Use the attached phase-two master as an EXACT identity lock: same face and red eyes, black fox ears with pale inner fur, long loose ash-purple and silver-violet hair streaming to left, black gold armor with tiny glowing red cracks, claw hands, red jewel, torn crimson black waist drapes, gold trimmed boots. Empty handed with NO weapon. Same 3/4 view facing RIGHT in every frame; head size, hair color, armor geometry and proportions remain absolutely identical. Crisp detailed pixel art with visible deliberate pixel clusters and limited palette, no smoothing or blur or broad glow. Character ankle/hip root x=60% of every cell, foot contact baseline y=90% of cell. Standing body height excluding ears/hair wisps approximately 74% of cell, entire silhouette stays at least 5% cell width from all boundaries. All poses belong in their own cell, no overlap or cropped hair, no drifting sideways or per-pose resizing. Flames confined to thin cloth/hair tips, do not flood silhouette. ACTION IDLE: A quiet menacing 16-frame seamless breathing loop. Both boots stay planted throughout, claw hands relaxed with a slow small finger flex, stern face. Chest rises and falls by only 1-2 pixels at game size. Hair ribbons and torn cloth gently sway left-right through a continuous wave, not growing longer. Frame1 rest, 2-4 inhale slightly, 5-8 exhale, 9-12 secondary sway, 13-16 return smoothly to the exact initial stance; frame16 nearly meets frame1 with no jump. DO NOT turn the head, jump, step or repeatedly crouch. All sixteen frames must be purposeful subtle different drawings.
